research_question: Does interval-specific thresholding or robust score normalization better preserve comparable three-state semantics across 5m/15m/60m without using trading returns?
prerequisite: X5C must provide adequate cross-carrier 15m/60m evidence; X5D may remain HOLD if 60m support is inadequate

INTERVAL_SPECIFIC_T1.threshold_estimation: estimate one symmetric T1 per interval from Development calibration data to match the predeclared reference SIDEWAYS occupancy target
INTERVAL_SPECIFIC_T1.reference_target: median 5m SIDEWAYS occupancy across Development carriers under V1 T1=2

ROBUST_NORMALIZED_SCORE.normalizer: interval-level robust scale estimated from Development calibration data
ROBUST_NORMALIZED_SCORE.universal_threshold_estimation: derive one symmetric normalized threshold from the 5m Development reference, then keep it fixed for 15m/60m evaluation

predeclared_evaluation_metrics: cross-carrier SIDEWAYS occupancy dispersion by interval
cross-carrier one-step self-transition dispersion by state
subperiod drift of occupancy and persistence
fraction of state assignments changed versus V1 raw baseline
monotonicity of strength ordering within interval
forbidden: grid searching thresholds for strategy PnL
using evaluation data to refit candidate parameters
promoting any X5D candidate into V1 without a later versioned representation decision
